anti_overlap: Focuses on entity count and ECS performance — not species generation (fd-botanical-procgen), terrain migration (fd-terrain-migration), beauty computation (fd-observer-beauty), or garden scope (fd-garden-art-sprint-scope)
decision_lens: Does the entity density model stay within the ECS performance budget? Where do entity count spikes break assumptions?
focus: Flora entity density: SmallVec sizing, day-boundary system budget, groundcover/entity succession, DeadWood spikes
name: fd-ecs-flora-entity-budget
persona: ECS performance engineer with expertise in entity budget management, archetype fragmentation, and batch system optimization
review_areas: Q5 entity count: Option A (~600 entities) vs Option B (~200 trees + groundcover grid) vs Option C (~50 notable only) — archetype memory and query cost at each tier
SmallVec<Entity, 4> sizing in EntitySpatialIndex: ancient groves with 5+ plants per tile (tree + understory + groundcover + dead wood + seedling) overflow the inline buffer
Day-boundary system budget: 7 flora systems × 600 entities at 10x game speed — is this still microseconds or does it become milliseconds?
DeadWood entity count spikes: a fire event could create 50+ DeadWood entities simultaneously — does the ECS handle bulk spawns gracefully?
Groundcover-to-entity succession: if Q5 Option B chosen, when does groundcover (grid) become a tree (entity)? The succession boundary needs clear rules.

severity_examples.condition: Dense tiles exceed SmallVec inline capacity
severity_examples.scenario: SmallVec overflow causes heap allocation per tile lookup, destroying O(1) spatial query guarantee

severity_examples.condition: No bulk spawn amortization for catastrophic events
severity_examples.scenario: Fire event spawns 100 DeadWood entities in one tick, causing frame stutter

severity_examples.condition: Flora components not grouped into a single archetype bundle
severity_examples.scenario: 600 flora entities with 6 components each fragments hecs archetypes, slowing unrelated queries

success_hints: Profile the actual entity count on a generated map. If tiles average 0.5 flora entities, 600 is fine. If forest tiles average 3+ entities (tree + undergrowth + seedling), the real count is 1800.
task_context: Flora design for Elf Revel — hecs ECS, 40×30 map (1200 tiles), WASM target, current entity count ~30-50 (elves + buildings + resources)
